name: Kshitij Bhatnagar
intro: I turn ideas into live products: the interface, the 3D, the AI and the infrastructure underneath. Six years of enterprise frontend by day, a studio of shipped side products by night.

skills.title: Interfaces that feel effortless
skills.body: Production React and TypeScript for enterprise clients since 2020: design systems, reusable component libraries, keyboard friendly accessible UI and pages that load fast.

skills.title: 3D and data you can touch
skills.body: Globes, particle fields and charts you drag. I use three.js, GSAP and d3 to turn dense numbers into something you understand by playing with it, like the particles on this page.
proof: Live data globe for 260 cities and 193 countries

skills.title: AI that does real work
skills.body: Agents, retrieval and speech pipelines with a human in the loop. I build with Claude, MCP, local models on Ollama, Whisper and Gemini, and I direct coding agents the way a lead directs a team.
proof: MCP server that Claude and Cursor can call
Nothing posts or spends without approval

skills.title: Shipped, secured and paid for

Cloudflare security on the product domains
Serverless Python, Cloud Run and Postgres
